Fable 5

Claude Fable 5 (공개 Mythos급)

오늘(6/9) 출시. 일반 사용 안전화한 Mythos급 — 대부분 벤치 SOTA. 고위험 주제는 Opus 4.8로 폴백(세션 <5%). Pro/Max/Team/Ent, 6/23 이후 크레딧제.

왜? 현재 가장 강한 공개 모델 — 난제·SWE·연구 품질 도약
학습: Opus 4.8 대비 체감, 폴백 발동 빈도, 6/23 이후 비용

v2.1.1525월 27일 수
기능 ×16개선 ×1보안 ×2Fix ×14
기능 /code-review --fix now applies review findings to your working tree after the review, surfacing reuse, simplification, and efficiency suggestions; /simplify now invokes /code-review --fix
기능 Skills and slash commands can now set disallowed-tools in frontmatter to remove tools from the model while the skill is active
기능 Added /reload-skills command to re-scan skill directories without restarting the session
기능 SessionStart hooks can now return reloadSkills: true to re-scan skill directories, making skills installed by the hook available in the same session
기능 SessionStart hooks can now set the session title via hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle on startup and resume
기능 Added a MessageDisplay hook event that lets hooks transform or hide assistant message text as it is displayed
기능 Added pluginSuggestionMarketplaces managed setting: admins can allowlist org marketplaces whose plugins may be suggested via context-aware tips
기능 claude plugin marketplace remove now accepts --scope user|project|local for symmetry with marketplace add, install, and uninstall
기능 Claude Code now switches to your configured --fallback-model for the rest of the session when the primary model is not found, instead of failing every request
기능 Auto mode no longer requires opt-in consent
기능 Vim mode: / in NORMAL mode now opens reverse history search (like Ctrl+R), matching bash/zsh vi-mode
기능 The /usage breakdown now includes large session files; files are scanned with a streaming read so memory usage stays flat
기능 Thinking summaries in the collapsed group now stay readable for at least 3 seconds, render as markdown, and cap at 10 lines (Ctrl+O shows the full thinking)
기능 In fullscreen mode, the "Thinking for Ns" indicator now counts up live while the model is thinking, and keeps its value if you interrupt mid-thought
기능 The post-response timer now shows "Waiting for N background agents/workflows to finish" when backgrounded agents or workflows are still running, and reports the cumulative time once their results are processed
기능 Added the session entrypoint as an OpenTelemetry metric attribute (app.entrypoint, opt-in via OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ENTRYPOINT=true)

blog

Claude Managed Agents 관리형 에이전트 — 프로덕션 10배 빠르게. Managed Agents + 메모리 에이전트에 메모리 내장. Dynamic workflows Claude Code에서 수백 에이전트 오케스트레이션. Claude Code desktop 개편 병렬 에이전트용 데스크톱 재설계. New connectors 일상용 커넥터 추가.

v0.69.0 → v0.135.0  ·  2025.12.10 – 2026.5.28

써볼 기능

기간
codex doctor

now reports richer environment, Git, terminal, app-server, and thread inventory diagnostics for support cases.

v0.135.0
/status

shows remote connection details and server version when the TUI is connected over a remote transport

v0.135.0
/permissions

now understands named permission profiles and displays configured custom profiles

v0.135.0

Vim mode gained text-object editing, improved word/line-end behavior, and a configurable interrupt-turn binding.

v0.135.0

Packaged Codex builds can discover and use the bundled patched zsh helper across supported macOS and Linux targets.

v0.135.0

The Python SDK now exposes friendly Sandbox presets for thread and turn APIs

v0.135.0
codex doctor

now reports richer environment, Git, terminal, app-server, and thread inventory diagnostics for support cases.

v0.135.0
/status

shows remote connection details and server version when the TUI is connected over a remote transport

v0.135.0
/permissions

now understands named permission profiles and displays configured custom profiles

v0.135.0
codex remote-control

now runs like a foreground command, waits for readiness, reports machine status, and keeps explicit daemon-style start/stop commands

v0.133.0
codex exec resume

now accepts --output-schema, so resumed automations can keep session context while still enforcing structured JSON output

v0.132.0
@

mentions now search files, directories, plugins, and skills in one picker, backed by app-server plugin metadata.

v0.131.0
codex exec --json

now reports reasoning-token usage for programmatic consumers

v0.125.0
/resume

can now jump directly to a session by ID or name from the TUI

v0.119.0

Added persisted /goal workflows with app-server APIs, model tools, runtime continuation, and TUI controls for create, pause, resume, and clear.

v0.128.0

Added codex update, configurable TUI keymaps, plan-mode nudges, action-required terminal titles, and active-turn /statusline and /title edits.

v0.128.0

Expanded permission profiles with built-in defaults, sandbox CLI profile selection, cwd controls, and active-profile metadata for clients.

v0.128.0

Improved plugin workflows with marketplace installation, remote bundle caching, remote uninstall, plugin-bundled hooks, hook enablement state, and external-agent config import.

v0.128.0
codex exec

now supports the prompt-plus-stdin workflow, so you can pipe input and still pass a separate prompt on the command line

v0.118.0
js_repl

now exposes codex.cwd and codex.homeDir, and saved codex.tool(...) / codex.emitImage(...) references keep working across cells.

v0.115.0
js_repl

can now dynamically import local .js and .mjs files, making it easier to reuse workspace scripts from the REPL

v0.111.0

Windows sandbox runs can now enforce proxy-only networking with OS-level egress rules, instead of relying on environment variables alone

v0.118.0

App-server clients can now start ChatGPT sign-in with a device code flow, which helps when browser callback login is unreliable or unavailable

v0.118.0

Custom model providers can now fetch and refresh short-lived bearer tokens dynamically, instead of being limited to static credentials from config or environment variables.

v0.118.0
/plan

now accepts inline prompt arguments and pasted images, and slash-command editing/highlighting in the TUI is more polished

v0.95.0

Added a direct install script for macOS and Linux and publish it as a GitHub release asset, using the existing platform payload (including codex and rg)

v0.106.0

Expanded the app-server v2 thread API with experimental thread-scoped realtime endpoints/notifications and a thread/unsubscribe flow to unload live threads without archiving them

v0.106.0

Promoted js_repl to /experimental, added startup compatibility checks with user-visible warnings, and lowered the validated minimum Node version to 22.22.0

v0.106.0

Enabled request_user_input in Default collaboration mode (not just Plan mode)

v0.106.0

Made 5.3-codex visible in the CLI model list for API users

v0.106.0
/models

metadata now includes upgrade migration markdown so clients can display richer guidance when suggesting model upgrades

v0.85.0

Added an optional SOCKS5 proxy listener with policy enforcement and config gating

v0.93.0

Plan mode now streams proposed plans into a dedicated TUI view, plus a feature-gated /plan shortcut for quick mode switching.

v0.93.0

Added /apps to browse connectors in TUI and $ insertion for app prompts

v0.93.0

App-server can now run in external auth mode, accepting ChatGPT auth tokens from a host app and requesting refreshes when needed

v0.93.0

Smart approvals are now enabled by default, with explicit approval prompts for MCP tool calls.

v0.93.0

TUI2: Normalize mouse wheel + trackpad scrolling across terminals; add tui.scroll_* config settings (PR #8357)

v0.77.0

Add allowed_sandbox_modes to requirements.toml to constrain permitted sandbox modes (PR #8298)

v0.77.0

MCP: OAuth login for streamable HTTP MCP servers no longer requires the rmcp_client feature flag (PR #8087)

v0.77.0

Improve fuzzy file search display/consistency by centralizing file-name derivation in codex-file-search (PR #8334)

v0.77.0

Update bundled model metadata (models.json) (PR #8168)

v0.77.0

Fix /undo interacting destructively with git staging / ghost commits (PR #8303)
